content.short: Thirdweb is a complete Web3 development framework providing SDKs, smart contracts, and infrastructure for building apps on Mantle.
content.description: Thirdweb is an end-to-end Web3 development platform that gives developers everything they need to build, launch, and scale blockchain applications on Mantle and other networks. The platform offers pre-built, audited smart contract templates for NFTs, tokens, marketplaces, staking, and DeFi. Its SDK supports multiple programming languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Unity. Thirdweb also provides in-app wallet infrastructure, payment processing APIs, and managed RPC nodes, making it a one-stop development environment for Mantle builders.
content.meta: Thirdweb is a complete Web3 development framework with SDKs and smart contracts for building on Mantle. Discover Thirdweb on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
